reviews.shade: ROUND LAB PINE CALMING CICA MASK SHEET 10ea
reviews.text: This CICA soothing mask is my absolute favorite! It’s perfect as an emergency skin savior or for after-sun care. The repairing and calming power is incredible. I always keep some on hand!
reviews.zh: 呢款 CICA 舒緩面膜係我嘅最愛！皮膚出事嗰陣或者曬後用都一流。修復同鎮靜效果勁到爆。我成日都會喺屋企 keep 住幾片！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB PINE CALMING CICA MASK SHEET 10ea
reviews.text: These masks are incredibly soothing! The sheet has a great stretch, allowing it to fit perfectly on my face with excellent adhesion. It stays put while I move around. My skin feels deeply moisturized and much calmer after just one use. Perfect for sensitive days—definitely a staple in my routine!
reviews.zh: 呢啲面膜舒緩效果一流！面膜紙好有彈力，可以緊貼我塊面，貼服度一流。點郁都唔會移位。用一次之後皮膚即刻覺得深層保濕，鎮靜咗好多。敏感日子必備——已經成為我護膚程序嘅定番！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB PINE CALMING CICA MASK SHEET 10ea
reviews.text: I think this is my go to when my skin is feeling a little more dry than usual or i feel like it’s irritated. My skin feels cool and refreshed after. Ive used it before bed or before an event, always leaves my skin feeling great!
reviews.zh: 當皮膚比平時乾燥或者覺得有啲受刺激，呢款就係我嘅首選。敷完之後皮膚涼浸浸又清新。睡前或者出活動前都用過，用完皮膚狀態都好好！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB PINE CALMING CICA MASK SHEET 10ea
reviews.text: I’m a big fan of Round Lab products, and this is one of my new favorite sheet masks. The serum is viscous and penetrates deep to clear the pores. The mask itself is the perfect thick-but-stretchy material. It helped calm a breakout after just one or two uses. My skin is calmer and glowy. Definite repurchase!
reviews.zh: 我係 Round Lab 嘅粉絲，呢款亦都係我最新嘅心水面膜之一。精華質感濃稠，可以滲入皮膚深處清毛孔。面膜紙本身係厚得啱啱好但又有彈性。用咗一兩次之後有助紓緩爆瘡。皮膚變得穩定同有水光。一定會再回購！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB PINE CALMING CICA MASK SHEET 10ea
reviews.text: This mask is a game changer for my rosacea prone skin. Whenever I'm dealing with a flare up, this helps calm everything down within minutes. My skin looks noticeably more even tones, feels smoothed instead of hot or tight!
reviews.zh: 對我呢個容易有玫瑰痤瘡嘅皮膚嚟講，呢款面膜係神物。每次皮膚發作，用咗幾分鐘就全部鎮靜返。膚色明顯均勻咗，皮膚變得滑順，唔再覺得發熱或者繃緊！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB PINE CALMING CICA MASK SHEET 10ea
reviews.text: These are my favorite sheet mask! Love the texture, the result, especially lovely on a hot day when you need cooling hydration. These are the only ones I will gift to other people cause I love them so much.
reviews.zh: 呢啲係我最鍾意嘅片裝面膜！鍾意佢嘅質地同效果，熱辣辣嘅日子想降溫保濕就最啱。鍾意到只會送呢款俾人。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB PINE CALMING CICA MASK SHEET 10ea
reviews.text: OMG I can't believe how nice this sheet mask is. It's my first time using it, it is so hydrating, soothing and calming. One of the best sheet masks I have used. Will definitely repurchase!
reviews.zh: 天呀，唔敢信呢款片裝面膜咁好用。第一次用就覺得超級保濕、舒緩又鎮靜。用過嘅最好片裝面膜之一。一定會再回購！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB PINE CALMING CICA MASK SHEET 10ea
reviews.text: Todas as estrelas para essa máscara facial. Eu sou apaixonada por ela. Hidrata e acalma minha pele como nenhuma outra. Tem um fel bem leve e hidratante. Gosto de deixar ela na geladeira antes de usar, fica perfeita para usar em duas quentes.
reviews.zh: 滿分俾呢款面膜。我對佢愛到不得了。保濕同鎮靜皮膚嘅效果冇嘢比得上。質感輕盈又保濕。鍾意用之前雪入雪櫃，熱辣辣嘅日子用就完美晒。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
